CMR.note: Document states nothing on authentication services.
Document states nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Only a national disability card is named, nothing on information or digital access.
No count or share of the population holding a national ID.
Nothing on a number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
Nothing on public registers keyed on the ID number.
Nothing on the national ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: UNHCR says a biometric identification programme in Cameroon has already given 25,000 refugees legal identification, and that a February 2025 framework issues identity documents including biometric cards to refugees.
